ABOUT VIDEO:
In this video I explain what parenting and null objects are inside Adobe After Effects. Parenting layers can be very helpful when creating animations in After Effects and using null objects can be essential for arranging already animated layers in your project. I go over a few examples and how to utilize these tools in After Effects.
